mapper.insert: INSERT INTO abnormal_records (id, mold_id, abnormal_type, measured_value, threshold_value, description, occurred_at, source_type, operator_id, device_id, linked_repair_id, linked_log_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{moldId}, #{abnormalType}, #{measuredValue}, #{thresholdValue}, #{description}, #{occurredAt}, #{sourceType}, #{operatorId}, #{deviceId}, #{linkedRepairId}, #{linkedLogId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, mold_id, abnormal_type, measured_value, threshold_value, description, occurred_at, source_type, operator_id, device_id, linked_repair_id, linked_log_id, created_at, updated_at FROM abnormal_records WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, mold_id, abnormal_type, measured_value, threshold_value, description, occurred_at, source_type, operator_id, device_id, linked_repair_id, linked_log_id, created_at, updated_at FROM abnormal_records WHERE mold_id = #{moldId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM abnormal_records WHERE mold_id = #{moldId} AND occurred_at >= #{since}
